fixtures.name: 01-health
fixtures.notes: Version identity. A deploy that changes economics moves the digest.

fixtures.name: 02-bundles-list
fixtures.notes: Datasets a professor may choose. Note the absence of a seed.

fixtures.name: 03-bundle-detail
fixtures.notes: Operator view, including the seed and the integrity check.

fixtures.name: 04-create-unknown-bundle
fixtures.notes: An unknown bundle is an error, never a fallback to a default.

fixtures.name: 05-create-mismatched-model
fixtures.notes: Hard rejection. A model built for another dataset is refused, not warned about.

fixtures.name: 06-create-duplicate-team-id
fixtures.notes: Two funds with one id would silently share a portfolio.

fixtures.name: 07-create-initial-state
fixtures.notes: Practice round is open on one property; the scored pool is untouched.

fixtures.name: 08-open-round-too-early
fixtures.notes: A round cannot be opened while one is open. Ordering is enforced.

fixtures.name: 09-resolve-practice-no-bids
fixtures.notes: Practice resolves with no decisions: the market moves, no fund transacts.

fixtures.name: 10-resolve-wrong-phase
fixtures.notes: A resolved round cannot be resolved twice.

fixtures.name: 11-open-round1
fixtures.notes: Round 1: four properties, and every reserve still hidden.

fixtures.name: 12-resolve-round1
fixtures.notes: One round, four outcomes: an over-levered bid refused, an unaffordable bid refused, a bid below the seller's reserve refused by the seller, and a valid bid that wins.

fixtures.name: 13-open-round2
fixtures.notes: Round 2, with round 1's purchases carried in the P&L bridge.

fixtures.name: 14-resolve-round2
fixtures.notes: Price tie broken by lower leverage; an identical price AND leverage settled by the seeded draw; three funds contesting one property; and a bid deliberately above the team's own policy ceiling.

fixtures.name: 16-resolve-round3
fixtures.notes: Three rounds of holdings: the bridge now shows income, interest and reserves.

fixtures.name: 18-resolve-round4
fixtures.notes: Final scored round. Equity is now the binding constraint for some funds.

fixtures.name: 19-open-after-final
fixtures.notes: Past the last round, opening reports completion instead of erroring.

fixtures.name: 20-team-view-student
fixtures.notes: One fund's own forecast, policy, book and overrides -- and nobody else's.

fixtures.name: 21-finalize-game
fixtures.notes: Standings, the analytics board, and the ten answers, from history alone.

fixtures.name: 22-finalize-idempotent
fixtures.notes: Finalising is a view, not a step: the second call returns the same state and the same debrief as the first.

fixtures.name: 23-create-edge-game
fixtures.notes: A second session on the same bundle, for boundary cases.

fixtures.name: 25-edge-open-round1
fixtures.notes: Every remaining edge case resolves from THIS state.

fixtures.name: 26-edge-bid-at-exact-reserve
fixtures.notes: A bid at exactly the reserve sells. The boundary is inclusive, so a tie against the seller's floor is not silently treated as a loss.

fixtures.name: 27-edge-bid-just-below-reserve
fixtures.notes: A thousand dollars below the reserve does not. Together with 26 this pins the boundary from both sides.

fixtures.name: 28-edge-ltv-at-max
fixtures.notes: Leverage at the property's ceiling is legal.

fixtures.name: 29-edge-ltv-above-max
fixtures.notes: Leverage one notch above the ceiling is refused, and refused legibly.

fixtures.name: 30-edge-duplicate-decision
fixtures.notes: Two bids from one fund for one property: the second is rejected, not silently merged.

fixtures.name: 31-edge-unknown-team
fixtures.notes: A bid from a fund that is not in the game is reported, not crashed on.

fixtures.name: 32-edge-bid-without-price
fixtures.notes: A BID missing its price is refused: an incomplete decision is not a pass.

fixtures.name: 33-edge-no-decisions
fixtures.notes: Nobody bids on anything: no sales, no error, the market still moves.

fixtures.name: 34-edge-identical-bid-and-ltv
fixtures.notes: Identical price and identical leverage: settled by the seeded draw, so the result is reproducible rather than arbitrary.

normalisation.engine_state: stored once under _states/ as gzipped canonical JSON, referenced by sha256
